items.title: Service Area Chair and Staff Announcements
notes: Councillor Caron announced that herself and Councillor Downer will be hosting their annual ward 5 spring town hall on Thursday, April 16, 2026 at 7 p.m. at Jean Little Public School, 56 Youngman Drive, Guelph.

motions.text: That the April 7, 2026 Committee of the Whole Consent Agenda, identified below, be adopted:
motions.text_html: 1. That the April 7, 2026 Committee of the Whole Consent Agenda, identified below, be adopted:

motions.item_title: 2025 Water Services’ Annual Report, Summary Report and Water Efficiency Strategy Progress Report - 2026-111
motions.text: That Guelph City Council receives the 2025 Water Services’ Annual Report and Summary Report. That Guelph City Council receives the 2025 Water Efficiency Strategy Progress Report.
motions.text_html:
1. That Guelph City Council receives the 2025 Water Services’ Annual Report and Summary Report.
  2. That Guelph City Council receives the 2025 Water Efficiency Strategy Progress Report.

motions.item_title: Proposal for Amendments to Taxi Tariff (Appendix A) - 2026-47
motions.text: That Council directs staff to amend City of Guelph By-law (2018) 20272 (Taxicab) to reflect a 6.7 per cent increase in taxicab rates, effective April 1, 2026 or at the time of the City’s meter check.
motions.text_html: 1. That Council directs staff to amend City of Guelph By-law (2018) 20272 (Taxicab) to reflect a 6.7 per cent increase in taxicab rates, effective April 1, 2026 or at the time of the City’s meter check.

motions.item_title: Delegated Authority Bylaw Amendment Update to Bring-Your-Own events - 2026-130
motions.text: That the Delegation of Authority By-law be amended, as noted in Attachment-1 to report 2026-130, to delegate authority to the City Clerk to designate events as "community” or “cultural” events for the purpose of enabling “bring-your-own-event” applications with the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario.
motions.text_html: 1. That the Delegation of Authority By-law be amended, as noted in Attachment-1 to report 2026-130, to delegate authority to the City Clerk to designate events as "community” or “cultural” events for the purpose of enabling “bring-your-own-event” applications with the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario.

motions.text: That the Traffic Calming Policy Update (2026), included as Attachment 1 to report 2026-129, titled "Traffic Calming Policy Update" dated April 7, 2026, be approved.
motions.text_html: 1. That the Traffic Calming Policy Update (2026), included as Attachment 1 to report 2026-129, titled "Traffic Calming Policy Update" dated April 7, 2026, be approved.
